description: Source code for the 'loslib' library in Lua, implementing OS-related functions such as execute, remove, rename, date/time operations, and environment variable access.

methods.name: os_execute
methods.description: Executes a system command, returning the result or whether a shell is available.

methods.name: os_remove
methods.description: Removes a file specified by filename.

methods.name: os_rename
methods.description: Renames a file from one name to another.

methods.name: os_getenv
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: os_clock
methods.description: Returns the CPU time used by the program.

methods.name: os_date
methods.description: Returns a date table or formatted date string based on input.

methods.name: os_time
methods.description: Returns the current time or a time based on a date table.

methods.name: os_difftime
methods.description: Returns the difference in seconds between two times.

methods.name: os_exit
methods.description: Terminates the program with a given status.
